newsitem.title: USA: ESC Medical names Eckhouse as chairman.
newsitem.headline: ESC Medical names Eckhouse as chairman.

text.p: ESC Medical Systems Ltd said Thursday it named Shimon Eckhouse as chairman of the board effective immediately, replacing Gideon Tolkowsky.
Eckhouse is currently president and chief executive officer and a founder of the company, and will retain those posts.
ESC Medical said Tolkowsky will continue to serve as a director. The company declined to say why Tolkowsky stepped down.
In January ESC Medical completed an initial public offering, followed by a subsequent secondary offering in July.
